summary: No necessary maintenance obligation is established. The old harness can reach spoiler rendering, including spoilers inside table cells. Discarding rendered output does not block those paths or violate an existing check. Coverage remains incomplete because selected change g0019 and the CMake defaults were not supplied as evidence.

claims.necessity_reason: The input controls parser flags and Markdown. A flag word containing 0x10000 followed by ||text|| reaches the new spoiler rendering path through the existing md_html call.

before.reason: The before source has no spoiler span type, and its pipe collector handles pipes as table or wiki link marks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The before collector creates single pipe marks only for table or wiki link handling.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS enabled, recognize ||text|| and render x-spoiler tags.
after.reason: The harness can supply the flag and text. The parser resolves paired double pipes into spoiler callbacks, and the HTML callbacks render both tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The spoiler flag causes double pipes to be collected as delimiter marks.
Inline analysis sends double pipe marks to spoiler resolution.
The pipe analyzer pairs an opener and closer.
Resolved pairs dispatch spoiler span callbacks.
The HTML opening callback renders the spoiler tag.
The HTML closing callback renders the matching tag.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe links the fuzz entry with the HTML renderer and parser libraries.

claims.comparison_reason: This spoiler behavior was unavailable before the change and is reachable through the same old harness afterward.

claims.necessity_reason: The old entry can supply both table and spoiler flags with Markdown containing ||x|| in a table cell. The after source preserves double pipes for spoiler parsing while using single pipes as cell boundaries.

before.requirement: Preserve double pipe spoiler delimiters within a table cell.
before.reason: The before collector creates single pipe marks for table parsing and has no spoiler delimiter behavior.

after.requirement: With table and spoiler parsing enabled, retain double pipes as spoiler delimiters inside cells while single pipes delimit cells.
after.reason: The collector makes adjacent pipes one two character mark. The table pass selects only one character pipe boundaries, and the subsequent cell inline pass can resolve spoiler delimiters.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Each selected table cell runs normal inline processing.
The cell inline pass analyzes double pipe spoiler marks.
Resolved double pipe marks dispatch spoiler callbacks.

claims.comparison_reason: The table cell spoiler behavior was unavailable before and has a direct input route through the unchanged harness afterward.

claims.necessity_reason: The old callback discards HTML on both sides, but the supplied md_html contract does not require storage for later inspection, and the complete harness has no output check.

before.requirement: Retain HTML chunks emitted by md_html for later inspection.
before.reason: The before wrapper accepts an output callback without imposing a retention requirement.

after.requirement: Retain HTML chunks emitted by md_html for later inspection.
after.reason: The callback interface remains the same; added spoiler tag rendering does not require the caller to retain chunks.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The new opening tag uses the existing rendering callback path.
The new closing tag uses the existing rendering callback path.

claims.comparison_reason: The callback discards output before and after, but storage is not a required behavior or an existing harness check.

missing_information: The diff hunk and repository-relative path for selected change g0019 are absent, so its target relevance cannot be assessed.
The before and after contents of the root and src CMakeLists.txt files are cataloged but not supplied as evidence; the build defaults cannot be fully verified.
